findings.problem: Still open from rounds 1 to 4 in a new form. Step 1 sits on the same line as the Solution label, and step 2 follows on the next line with no blank line. In CommonMark an ordered list that interrupts a paragraph must start at 1, so the '2.' line is read as paragraph text and both steps render as one paragraph, not a numbered list. Every other multi-step solution puts the label on its own line. No step is skipped, so this is Minor.
